hitNote: Hit times are estimates from the cut points and the actions; the animatic replaces them with the frames where our own swings land.
note: Cut points and durations follow the owner's local reference; everything else is our own staging. Times are cut-relative seconds. Subjects: P printer; K kicker (purple tie); T tall batter (white shirt, dark tie); S small batter (striped shirt, red tie).

music.cue: printer rap, extended to the cut length
music.note: Cue starts at the walk, under the cut to shot 1.

shots.subject: P

shots.action: none; wind in the grass

shots.subject: T

shots.action: the walk out begins; bat held at the side

shots.subject: S

shots.action: S walks in, looking down at the printer

shots.subject: K

shots.action: K's flying kick toward P

shots.action: K hefts the bat, T and S step back and watch

shots.subject: P
shots.frame: high close on the opened printer: green board, red roller, torn lid; a sheet of paper flutters

shots.subject: P
shots.frame: flash cut: the printer shakes under a boot
shots.action: kick on the printer

shots.subject: T
shots.frame: tight on T's torso, tie swinging, S's fist coming in at the right

shots.subject: P
shots.frame: ground close on the wreck, a boot stamps into frame, plastic pieces lying round

shots.subject: S,T,K

shots.subject: P
shots.frame: close on the open case from the side: boards, wires, a bar of white plastic flying up

shots.subject: T,S,K
shots.frame: medium three-shot, S with the bat, K beside him, T watching, horizon tilted
shots.move: slow push, then a short tilt

shots.subject: P
shots.frame: close: the bat head coming down into the case, a spray of parts
